verdict.rationale: dlt's schema and data contracts let you define rules (e.g., evolve/freeze/discard) that trigger automatically when a schema-drift 'event' occurs during a pipeline run, and merge/incremental logic auto-triggers upserts on new/changed records — a narrow form of rule-based automation. However there is no evidence of a general-purpose event/trigger rules engine (e.g., arbitrary conditional actions on custom events, webhooks, or business-rule triggers) beyond schema/data handling. Missing for 10: a documented general event-trigger/rules API, examples of custom conditional actions beyond schema contracts, and any evidence of arbitrary event-based automation outside data ingestion mechanics.
